name: Ninomiya (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ninomiya town emblem in red: a winged ring enclosing a stylised hourglass shape.
history: Municipal flag of Ninomiya, a town in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 April 1958.

features.role: Ninomiya town emblem — a winged ring enclosing a stylised hourglass shape
